chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad Al-Kindi, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Mithami, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Al-Mufaddal, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: Fatima (peace be upon her) went to a pillar in the Masjid, and she was addressing the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): 'Events have occurred after you, and differences. Had you witnessed them, the matter would not have increased so much. We have missed you as the earth misses its downpour of rain. And your people are in disturbance, so witness them and do not be absent.'

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ وَابِلَهَا: the earth and its downpour of rain

ai.seo_question: What did Fatima (peace be upon her) say to the Prophet regarding the events after his time?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* captures the profound emotional impact of the Prophet's passing through Fatima al-Zahra's (peace be upon her) direct address to him from a pillar in the Masjid, highlighting the immediate social and spiritual vacuum left by his departure. The metaphor of the earth missing its rain underscores the unique role of the Prophet as a source of divine sustenance and guidance, while her plea for him to 'witness' reflects the Shia belief in the continued spiritual presence and awareness of the Imams and the Prophet regarding the state of the Ummah.

en.hubeali: H 15011 – Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hassan Bin Muhammad Al-Kindy, from Ahmad Bin Al-Hassan Al-Maysami, from Aban Bin Usman, from Muhammad Bin Al-Mufazzal who said:

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Fatimaasws went to a pillar in the Masjid, and sheasws was addressing the Holy Prophetsaww: ‘Events have occurred after yousaww, and differences. Had youas witnessed them, they would not have increased so much. Weasws have missed youas like the missing of the earth of its downpour of rain. And yoursaww people are in disturbance, so witness them and do not be absent’.
en.sarwar: 565. Aban, from Abu Baseer, who said the following:

Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said: ‘Once the Rasool Allah (saww) was in the Masjid, when every high thing was lowered for him (saww) and every low thing was raised for him (saww), to the extent that he (saww) saw Ja’far (as) fighting the infidels. He (as) got killed. So the Messenger (saww) said: ‘Ja’far has been killed’, and a severe pain struck him (as) in his (saww) stomach’.
